yt_description:
Ever wondered how to sort a stack of pancakes? 🤔 We dive deep into the quirky world of Pancake Sort, a surprisingly simple yet delightfully bizarre sorting algorithm. Watch as we visualize its unique flip-and-sort strategy! 🥞✨

What is Pancake Sort? 
It's a sorting algorithm that only uses 'flips' to sort an array. Imagine a stack of pancakes of different sizes, and you can only flip the top 'k' pancakes. How do you get them in order from smallest to largest?

In this video, we'll cover:
✅ The core concept of Pancake Sort
✅ Step-by-step visualization of the algorithm
✅ Its time complexity and why it's not the most efficient (but oh so fun!)
✅ Real-world (ish) analogies and use cases
